items.prompt: Question 1: Why do you want to study this course or subject? Question 2: How have your qualifications and studies helped you to prepare for this course or subject? Question 3: What else have you done to prepare outside of education, and why are these experiences useful?
items.ru: Личное заявление в UCAS: около 4 000 знаков или 47 строк, три отдельных вопроса.
items.evidence: Your personal statement is a piece of writing - about 4,000 characters or 47 lines of text - which you will include in your application. You do not need to list your qualifications here, as there will be a separate section of the application form for recording those details (along with details of your qualifications and your reference). The personal statement is split into three separate questions.

items.ru: Рекомендацию даёт референт — академический или профессиональный контакт, не друг и не родственник; ссылку присылает UCAS.
items.evidence: You will need to nominate a referee who must be an academic or professional contact (not a friend or family member). Your referee will receive a secure link from UCAS to provide your reference and predicted grades (where applicable) directly.

items.ru: Иногда на собеседование приглашают зрелых поступающих — обсудить знания и мотивацию.
items.evidence: In some cases, mature applicants will be invited to an interview (for example, to discuss your current knowledge and your motivations for returning study)

note: Опыт работы и внеучебные занятия входят в личное заявление; отдельного списка активностей нет.
